## What you did
- You prepared the prod PG17 blue/green cutover: the Terraform plan now shows 2 changes and no destruction, the runbook is written, the rehearsal on a snapshot clone measured 74 seconds of write downtime with no data mismatch, and you tore down the rehearsal clone to stop costs. [1]

## What changed
- The cutover window moved from Saturday 21/11 to Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC, because Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC; Maya confirmed this with Sam and said you can update the runbook and merge #321. [8]
- Renovate opened PR #320 to upgrade the AWS Terraform provider from 5.80 to 5.82; automerge is disabled. [4]

## What is still open
- Merge PR #321 after updating the runbook for the new Sunday window; Maya approved it but asked to wait until the window was confirmed with Fernhill. [3][8]
- Ping Daniel Levi when you start the switchover: he is on call for the API side on Sunday. [7]
- Give Lior Ben-David 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so he can pause ingest consumers; his workers read DATABASE_URL from SSM and need no change. [9]
- Rehearse rollback on a fresh clone Thursday 19/11 and add it to the runbook: after switchover the old instance is renamed and diverges, so rolling back is not just switching back. [1]
